# Cats Whiskers

> > A charming independent gift shop in Bishops Cleeve, Cotswolds, specializing in greeting cards, gifts, and stationery from renowned designers and brands.

Cats Whiskers is a curated gift retailer located in Gloucestershire that offers an extensive catalog of greeting cards, seasonal collections, and gift items. The shop features products from popular designers and brands including Alex Clark, Jellycat, Gisela Graham, East of India, and Quentin Blake collaborations.

- [All Cards](https://catswhiskersuk.com/cards-gifts-cards-all-cards.irc): All cards catalog with birthday and greeting card options

- [Anniversary & Love Cards](https://catswhiskersuk.com/cards-gifts-cards-all-cards-anniversarylove.irc): Anniversary and love greeting cards collection
- [Baby & Christening Cards](https://catswhiskersuk.com/cards-gifts-cards-all-cards-babychristening.irc): Baby and christening greeting cards including Miffy designs
